senses.definition_en: One who has performed the pilgrimage to Mecca, and on that account dresses in white;

additional_information: whence applied as an a. white, to white animals; dòkò àlǎʒì; cf. alaháji.
source_excerpt: àlǎʒì n. One who has performed the pilgrimage to Mecca, and on that account dresses in white; whence applied as an a. white, to white animals; dòkò àlǎʒì; cf. alaháji.
